questions.question: 2. In order to have a faster inverter circuit what can be done?

explanations.a: Incorrect. Decreasing supply voltage slows down the inverter circuit.
explanations.b: Correct. Decreasing the threshold voltage makes the inverter circuit faster.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Increasing parasitic capacitance slows down the inverter circuit.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Decreasing W/L ratio reduces current and slows down the inverter.
